policy: The shareable build (repurposing_view.py run --source shareable) embeds a third-party row only when its provenance is listed here. Every other third-party row is represented by an identifier and by counts. An attribution is never removed to make data look distributable: the footer of the output lists the sources actually embedded, and separately the sources that contributed counts or identifiers only. Policy conclusions are those of the licence analysis of 2026-10-28 (IT4 C4); this file implements the mechanism and decides nothing new. It is not legal advice.

own_text.what: text and computations produced in this repository: candidate cards, needs, priorities and dispositions, counts
own_text.licence: repository licence for original text; third-party rows are not covered by it
